build_detectron_package: build the detectron package with cython extensions for bbox and nms utilities
build_cython_bbox_extension: build the cython_bbox extension module from detectron/utils/cython_bbox.pyx with numpy includes

review_setup_py: review the setup.py build configuration for detectron cython extensions and numpy include paths
